post.summary: Create a payment link for an item, without a sale (deprecated)
post.description: Deprecated: use POST /api/v1/sales/{saleId}/payment-links, which links only the plan the customer agreed to on one of the shop's sales. This Layer 1 operation makes a payable link with no sale and no customer agreement, and its payment status cannot be read back (GET /api/v1/payments/{orderId}/status answers only for a sale's payment), so it sends no Location header. It stays until the owner decides to remove it. Re-quotes the chosen offer server-side, freezes its plan and asks the gateway for a payment link exactly once per Idempotency-Key; the call is never retried. The same key and body return the original 201 response. A gateway timeout answers 504 and the key then answers 409 PAYMENT_LINK_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: start again with a new key (ADR 0005). Layer 1 gateway endpoint that needs the merchant bearer token since Layer 2 (plan Q16) and is limited per shop (429 with Retry-After). Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

post.summary: Receive a payment notification from the gateway
post.description: Called by the payment gateway, not by our apps. The body is form-encoded key/value text [Verify] of at most 16 KiB. Its signature (CHECKSUMHASH) is verified over every field before any field is read; a mismatch answers 401 and is audited. A verified notification answers 202 with no body, also when it repeats an earlier one (no extra effect) or names an order that is not ours. Authenticated by the signature only; no credentials (ADR 0009). A generous per-client limit applies (429 with Retry-After).

post.summary: Pair a counter device with the shop id and PIN
post.description: Trades the shop id and the shop's 6-digit pairing PIN for a bearer token for this device. The token is shown once and only its hash is stored; it lasts 12 hours by default. This endpoint needs no credentials and is rate-limited per client address. An unknown shop and a wrong PIN get the same 401; 5 wrong PINs in a row lock the shop for 15 minutes (429 with Retry-After). Location points at the signed-in profile. The answer is never cached (Cache-Control: no-store).

ExplanationSource.title: ExplanationSource
ExplanationSource.description: Who wrote the explanation: AI text that passed the number audit, or the standard text.

FieldErrorResponse.title: FieldErrorResponse
FieldErrorResponse.description: One invalid request field, named as on the wire, with an English message.

FunnelDropResponse.title: FunnelDropResponse
FunnelDropResponse.description: The largest fall between two shown adjacent stages; afterStage is the earlier stage.

FunnelReportResponse.title: FunnelReportResponse
FunnelReportResponse.description: M5 "Where customers drop off": the period's started sales that are no longer CHOOSING.

FunnelStage.title: FunnelStage
FunnelStage.description:
A step a sale reached; stored by value, so a rename needs a migration.

The merchant sees only counts per stage, never which sale or customer reached which step
(rule 6). In Layer 2 live code records STARTED, AGREED and PAID; BUDGET_TOLD and PLANS_VIEWED
come from the Layer 3 customer flow and from the step 2.4 demo seed.

FunnelStageCountResponse.title: FunnelStageCountResponse
FunnelStageCountResponse.description: How many of the period's sales reached one stage.

GiveConsentRequest.title: GiveConsentRequest
GiveConsentRequest.description:
The plan agreed to, the figures C9 showed for it, the 6-digit code and the agreement.

The plan is an offer on the session's item at the sale price (ADR 0022 decision 1). It is
re-quoted server-side; if the shown monthly or total no longer match, the answer is 409
SHOWN_PLAN_CHANGED and nothing is recorded.

HandoffPaymentStatus.title: HandoffPaymentStatus
HandoffPaymentStatus.description: Where an agreed sale's payment stands, as M4 shows it; never "declined" (spec 7.5).

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Body returned by GET /health while the process is able to serve requests.

HighlightedAmountKind.title: HighlightedAmountKind
HighlightedAmountKind.description: Which plan figure a highlighted amount is (C7 shows two beside the text).

HighlightedAmountResponse.title: HighlightedAmountResponse
HighlightedAmountResponse.description: One figure the text mentions, exactly as the engine computed it, in integer paise.

paymentUrl.title: Paymenturl
paymentUrl.description: Show it on the tablet as a QR code with a copy button; it is never sent anywhere by us.

LatestPaymentLinkResponse.title: LatestPaymentLinkResponse
LatestPaymentLinkResponse.description: The sale's newest payment link and where its payment stands.

LongerNoCostPlanParametersResponse.title: LongerNoCostPlanParametersResponse
LongerNoCostPlanParametersResponse.description: Figures for "ask the brand for a longer no-cost plan" on the insight product.

MerchantProfileResponse.title: MerchantProfileResponse
MerchantProfileResponse.description: The signed-in shop and device, as the merchant app shows them in its header.

budgetTotalCustomerCount.title: Budgettotalcustomercount
budgetTotalCustomerCount.description: Null when suppressed: 1 to 4, or a 0 after a cohort of 1 to 4 finished sales.

MissedSalesReportResponse.title: MissedSalesReportResponse
MissedSalesReportResponse.description: M5 "Missed sales": who wanted less than every no-extra-cost plan, and the buckets.

MoneyDueResponse.title: MoneyDueResponse
MoneyDueResponse.description: What brands still owe the shop, in batch order; not filtered by any range (plan Q13).

OfferSnapshotResponse.title: OfferSnapshotResponse
OfferSnapshotResponse.description:
The exact plan frozen when the link was made: tenure - 1 regular installments, then a last.

The amounts are our schedule's, so they add up to totalPayableInPaise to the paisa.

OffersResponse.title: OffersResponse
OffersResponse.description: Every offer the gateway quotes for the item, in the gateway's order; none is hidden.

OtpChallengeResponse.title: OtpChallengeResponse
OtpChallengeResponse.description: Where the code went (only the last two digits), when it ends, resends and how many tries.

shopId.title: Shopid
shopId.description: The shop's id, as printed for the shop.

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: The shop's 6-digit pairing PIN, as text so leading zeros survive.

PairDeviceRequest.title: PairDeviceRequest
PairDeviceRequest.description: The shop id and 6-digit pairing PIN typed on the counter device (M1).

PaymentLinkResponse.title: PaymentLinkResponse
PaymentLinkResponse.description:
The link to hand to the customer, as created; poll the Location URL for later status.

status is always the status the link had when it was created (AWAITING_PAYMENT), so a replay
with the same Idempotency-Key returns exactly the original response (api-conventions.md
section 5). The current status is served by GET /api/v1/payments/{orderId}/status.

PaymentStatusResponse.title: PaymentStatusResponse
PaymentStatusResponse.description:
Where one payment stands, confirmed with the gateway server-side on this request.

amountPaidInPaise is set only when the gateway reports the payment as paid; it can be below
the link amount when a discount applied.

PlanAlternativeResponse.title: PlanAlternativeResponse
PlanAlternativeResponse.description:
One option: down payment, longer tenure or cheaper model, kept even if it costs more.

financedAmountInPaise is what the plan spreads over its months: the price less any down
payment. The two monthly figures are the lender's quoted ones; isLowerMonthlyAmount and the
budget fit compare the largest single installments (ADR 0020 decision 3).

PlanAlternativesRequest.title: PlanAlternativesRequest
PlanAlternativesRequest.description: The plan the customer is looking at; alternatives are found for it.

PlanAlternativesResponse.title: PlanAlternativesResponse
PlanAlternativesResponse.description: The chosen plan and every option; hasLowerMonthlyAlternative false is "nothing better".

PlanComfortResponse.title: PlanComfortResponse
PlanComfortResponse.description:
One plan's band and shares of monthly inflow; advice, not a credit decision.

comfortRatioInBasisPoints is (existing EMIs + this plan) / inflow, rounded half-up once, and
the band is classified on it. The two shares are rounded on their own, so they may add up to
one basis point more or less than the total (ADR 0020 decision 4).

PlanExplanationRequest.title: PlanExplanationRequest
PlanExplanationRequest.description: The plan the customer wants explained; the language comes from Accept-Language.

text.title: Text
examples: No-cost EMI: you pay ₹3,667 each month for 6 months. The extra you pay in total is ₹0, so nothing is added to the price.

PlanExplanationResponse.title: PlanExplanationResponse
PlanExplanationResponse.description:
The explanation text and the figures it mentions; source TEMPLATE is the standard text.

source AI_AUDITED is AI text whose every number passed the number audit. Every rupee amount
in the text is one of highlightedAmounts, shown in whole rupees. explanationId names this
shown text for speech synthesis.

PlanReasonCode.title: PlanReasonCode
PlanReasonCode.description:
A fact about a plan that the frontend turns into translated text (ADR 0020 decision 5).

Declaration order is the order codes are listed on a plan. There is deliberately no code that
recommends a plan (CLAUDE.md section 2, rule 7).

detail.title: Detail
examples: The chosen offer is not quoted for this item and price.

fieldErrors.title: Fielderrors
fieldErrors.description: Set only on request validation problems.

ProblemDetailsResponse.title: ProblemDetailsResponse
ProblemDetailsResponse.description:
An error: a stable code for the UI to translate and an English detail for developers.

It never holds a stack trace, SQL, a vendor payload or personal data.

ProductInsightResponse.title: ProductInsightResponse
ProductInsightResponse.description: The product most missed sales were for, with its quoted figures.

ProductsResponse.title: ProductsResponse
ProductsResponse.description: The merchant's products, dearest first then by name; another shop's never appear.

PublicPaymentStatus.title: PublicPaymentStatus
PublicPaymentStatus.description:
Where a payment stands, as the UIs see it; decoupled from the stored attempt status.

The stored statuses may be renamed or split later without breaking the wire contract.

ReceiptStatus.title: ReceiptStatus
ReceiptStatus.description:
Where the purchase stands on C10; a payment that did not go through explains the next step.

READY_TO_PAY is the hand-off: the merchant now takes payment on Paytm. PAYMENT_PENDING means
the merchant started a payment whose outcome is not known yet.

ReportingRange.title: ReportingRange
ReportingRange.description: Which span of the shop's calendar a report covers (M5's Today, This week, This month).

sessionCode.title: Sessioncode
sessionCode.description: Four digits to tell sales apart on screen; never a credential.

statusChangedAt.title: Statuschangedat
statusChangedAt.description: When the status last changed, UTC.

SaleDetailResponse.title: SaleDetailResponse
SaleDetailResponse.description: One sale with its product id and start; qr is set only in the answer that issued it.

paymentConfirmedAt.title: Paymentconfirmedat
paymentConfirmedAt.description: When the gateway's confirmed payment moved the sale to PAID, UTC.

SaleHandoffResponse.title: SaleHandoffResponse
SaleHandoffResponse.description: M4: the sale with its agreed plan (monthly, extra and total), EDC steps and latest link.

paymentUrl.title: Paymenturl
paymentUrl.description: Show it on the tablet as a QR code with a copy button; it is never sent anywhere by us.

SalePaymentLinkResponse.title: SalePaymentLinkResponse

paymentConfirmedAt.title: Paymentconfirmedat
paymentConfirmedAt.description: When the gateway's confirmed payment moved the sale to PAID, UTC.

SalePaymentStatusResponse.title: SalePaymentStatusResponse
SalePaymentStatusResponse.description: Where an agreed sale's payment stands; the confirmation time is set only once PAID.

SaleStatus.title: SaleStatus
SaleStatus.description:
The five merchant-visible sale statuses; stored by value, so a rename needs a migration.

None of them reveals a customer's step-by-step progress: CHOOSING covers everything from the
QR scan to the moment the customer agrees to a plan.

SaleStatusEventPayload.title: SaleStatusEventPayload
SaleStatusEventPayload.description: The data of one sale-status event: which sale, its status now and since when.

sessionCode.title: Sessioncode
sessionCode.description: Four digits to tell sales apart on screen; never a credential.

statusChangedAt.title: Statuschangedat
statusChangedAt.description: When the status last changed, UTC.

SaleSummaryResponse.title: SaleSummaryResponse
SaleSummaryResponse.description: One sale on the counter list: code, product, price, status and, once agreed, the plan.

SalesView.title: SalesView
SalesView.description: Which list of sales to read; the counter view is the only one in Layer 2.

periodStartDate.title: Periodstartdate
periodStartDate.description: The week's Monday (IST), as YYYY-MM-DD; a later week is refused.

SendWeeklyMessageRequest.title: SendWeeklyMessageRequest
SendWeeklyMessageRequest.description: Which week's message to mark sent.

SpeechSynthesisRequest.title: SpeechSynthesisRequest
SpeechSynthesisRequest.description: Which shown explanation to speak; the client never supplies the text itself.

SpeechTranscriptionPurpose.title: SpeechTranscriptionPurpose
SpeechTranscriptionPurpose.description: Which screen the recording is for: the C2 budget or the C8 teach-back answer.

SpeechTranscriptionResponse.title: SpeechTranscriptionResponse
SpeechTranscriptionResponse.description:
What was heard and the one amount in it; the budget is not changed by this answer.

recognisedAmountInPaise is null when no single amount was heard. isLikelyMisheard asks the
customer to check: no single amount, zero, or more each month than the item's price.

qrToken.title: Qrtoken
qrToken.description: The token after #t= in the QR link, sent as is.

StartCustomerSessionRequest.title: StartCustomerSessionRequest
StartCustomerSessionRequest.description: The token read from the QR the merchant shows; it is never logged.

StartSaleRequest.title: StartSaleRequest
StartSaleRequest.description: The product the customer wants; the price is always the catalogue list price.

SuggestedActionsResponse.title: SuggestedActionsResponse
SuggestedActionsResponse.description: M5 "What you can do to sell more", in a stable order; empty when nothing applies.

SuggestedNoCostTenureResponse.title: SuggestedNoCostTenureResponse
SuggestedNoCostTenureResponse.description: A longer no-cost tenure and its regular monthly installment on the list price.

answerText.title: Answertext
examples: 3,667 every month for 6 months, nothing extra

TeachBackRequest.title: TeachBackRequest
TeachBackRequest.description: The plan and the customer's answer in their own words (typed or transcribed).

body.title: Body
examples: You will pay ₹3,667 every month for 6 months. Nothing extra on top of ₹22,000.

TeachBackResponse.title: TeachBackResponse
TeachBackResponse.description:
Advisory feedback: CLOSE_ENOUGH or TRY_AGAIN, with the plan's terms restated.

heardText echoes the monthly amount heard (null when none); highlightedAmounts are the
engine's figures. Nothing is stored and consent is never blocked.

TeachBackResult.title: TeachBackResult
TeachBackResult.description: Advisory only: TRY_AGAIN never blocks consent, it offers to explain the plan again.

WeeklyMessageLanguagesResponse.title: WeeklyMessageLanguagesResponse
WeeklyMessageLanguagesResponse.description: The same message in English (en) and Tamil (ta, draft wording).

WeeklyMessageResponse.title: WeeklyMessageResponse
WeeklyMessageResponse.description: A week's message; source is AI_AUDITED when any language is audited AI text.

WeeklyMessageTextResponse.title: WeeklyMessageTextResponse
WeeklyMessageTextResponse.description:
One language's message: a title and its paragraphs (a left-out sentence is just absent).

source AI_AUDITED is AI text whose every number passed the audit; TEMPLATE is the standard
text, also used whenever AI is off, unavailable or fails the audit.

MerchantBearerToken.description: The accessToken from POST /api/v1/merchants/pairing, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It lasts 12 hours by default; pair again after.

CustomerSessionToken.description: The sessionToken from POST /customer-sessions; short-lived and bound to one session. Missing, wrong or ended tokens answer 401 CUSTOMER_SESSION_TOKEN_INVALID.
CustomerSessionToken.name: X-Customer-Session-Token
